citations.claim: The AirtableClient class encapsulates all Airtable API interactions with comprehensive authentication management
CLI application built with Typer framework and Rich console for formatted output
Data transformation functions including _simplify_cell and _compact_record for cleaning Airtable data
URL parser extracts base, table, view, page, and record IDs from Airtable URLs
Comprehensive preflight_access method provides authentication and permission diagnostics
Four main CLI commands: bases, schema, records, and from_url for different Airtable operations
Uses Airtable REST API endpoints at api.airtable.com/v0 and meta endpoints
Integration with centaur SDK for secret management and 1Password integration
External dependencies include httpx, typer, rich, and python-dotenv
HTTP transport layer built on httpx with configurable timeouts and headers
Comprehensive error handling with detailed HTTP status code classification
list_records method supports pagination, filtering, and field selection with data compaction
snapshot_from_url creates tabular snapshots with consistent column ordering
Tool configuration specifies AIRTABLE_API_KEY as HTTP secret for api.airtable.com
HTTP mocking capabilities for testing without network dependencies
